verdict.rationale: LocalAI's multi-user auth (LOCALAI_AUTH=true) provides per-user API keys and admin/user roles, which is the closest thing to credential scoping, but there is no documented ability to issue fine-grained, least-privilege scoped credentials specifically for an agent (e.g., restricting to specific models, tools, or MCP servers per key). missing for 10: explicit scope/permission definitions per API key, agent-specific credential issuance, and any evidence of least-privilege enforcement beyond generic user roles.
